tier1.text: Each posterior tibial vein collects blood along the back of the tibia, or shinbone. The posterior tibial vein begins where two plantar veins from the underside of the foot meet. The posterior tibial vein then joins two other leg veins to form the popliteal vein behind the knee.

sentences.text: Each posterior tibial vein collects blood along the back of the tibia, or shinbone.

quotes.quote: The posterior tibial vein drains the posterior surface of the tibia and joins the popliteal vein.

quotes.quote: tibia: shin bone; the large, weight-bearing bone located on the medial side of the leg
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The posterior tibial vein begins where two plantar veins from the underside of the foot meet.

quotes.quote: A vein in the foot that is formed by the union of the external and internal plantar veins and which becomes the popliteal vein.
quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

quotes.quote: The superior surface of the foot drains into the digital veins, and the inferior surface drains into the plantar veins
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The posterior tibial vein then joins two other leg veins to form the popliteal vein behind the knee.

quotes.quote: popliteal vein: continuation of the femoral vein behind the knee; drains the region behind the knee and forms from the fusion of the fibular and anterior and posterior tibial veins
